title: B1 code addendum to addendum 2: the code, tests and CPU test of the lyric clock B1
custody: This addendum is committed and pushed before Run B and before addendum 3 (the B2 registration), and that push is its external timestamp. It changes nothing that addendum 2 registers: items, seeds, arms, intervention, measurement and rule stay as section e6_readout ('B1, fixed now') states them.

fill_ins.text: The five arms of a draw are named nohook (beta 0: no hook is entered), align1, align2 and align4 (beta 1, 2 and 4 on the seven alignment heads) and random2 (beta 2 on registered random set r for draw r, which equals readout.random_head_sets()[r]). Runs go in the order item, draw, arm.

Recall of a clip: the lyric words found by the registered in-order exact matching (dacapo.words.match_words over Whisper's normalised word chunks; chunks with an empty word or no start time are dropped, as in readout.py), divided by the number of lyric words. An arm's recall and vocal-gate rate are means over its 36 planned clips. A missing, failed or unscored clip counts as recall 0 and gate failed.

A clip is evaluable if it passes E6's vocal gate and at least 4 lyric words are matched, as in the E6 read-out. Its error is the median over the matched words of |Whisper onset - written onset|. An item's error in an arm is the median of the errors of its evaluable draws.

Word j sings note j. Its written onset is the note's start in beats x 0.6 s (100 BPM), from experiments/e4_sing/manifest.json. The last word's window ends at its note end, (start + dur) x 0.6 s; dur in the manifest is already 0.9 of the note's length, so item00 ends at 11.94 s.

DiT query frame q covers latent frames 2q and 2q+1 and is placed at its centre, 0.08q + 0.04 s. It lies in word j's window if onset_j <= centre < onset_(j+1). Word j's keys are s plus its token indices in the pure lyric, with s from ACE-Step's _extract_lyric_segment (9 for these lines, so the first word is key 12). The bias goes to the steered heads of layers 2-6 at all 8 steps; the hook asserts that every biased key lies below n_lyr and n_lyr below Lk.

An item with no evaluable draw in the arm or at beta 0, or with a beta 0 error of 0, is not improved: it fails the 30% count and enters the medians with reduction 0. A computed reduction enters as it is, negative values included.

Seconds and reductions are rounded to 1e-6 before any comparison, as in E6. A rounded reduction of 0.30 counts as 30%. The guards compare the rounded change in recall and in gate rate with -0.10. The random arm's rounded median reduction must be strictly below the rounded half of beta 2's.

Integrity can block a verdict but never create one. The verdict is 'technical' unless all of these hold: the eight addendum 2 files and the B1 code hash to their registered values at generation (every run row records them) and at decision; readout.py check-gate accepts Run A's gate (E6_RES=results/gpu_run2); every scored clip used Whisper large-v3 at the pinned revision; every generated clip has its pre-normalisation peak; at most 9 of the 180 runs are missing, failed or unscored; every hooked run made 40 hook calls with every biased key inside the lyric, and every no-hook run made none.
A run that raises is tried at most 3 times with the same seeds. The ledgers are append-only, and a run counts as generated only while its WAV and pred_latents hash to its ledger row.

'supported' if conditions 1-3 hold and 'not supported' otherwise, with the failed conditions named; 'technical' if integrity fails; 'test only' for any run with a test flag (the tiny CPU scale, a test Whisper model, unregistered code). Labels describe each condition and never change the verdict.

From addendum 2's exploratory list, the parts that apply to B1, per arm: the share of matched words within 0.25 s of the written onset, the median signed error, the error without each clip's first matched word, and 95% intervals from a bootstrap over items (10,000 resamples, seed 0) for the median reduction and the items improved.
Every run goes through dacapo.ace.generate at batch 1 with sdpa attention and the E5 v2 determinism settings. Clips are written by soundfile as 16-bit PCM WAV, pred_latents as float32 .npy.

The tiny CPU scale (run_b1.py --scale tiny, part of experiments/run_b.py --scale tiny) runs item00 draw 0 without the hook and at beta 2 on the alignment heads, with its own seeds (dacapo.seeds.run_seeds('runB1-tiny', item, draw)) and a test Whisper, and every verdict it writes is 'test only'. Before this addendum, the tiny scale used the registered seeds of those two runs (DiT seed 63000, pin 963000): the code tests on this machine's CPU generated these two planned runs several times and scored them with whisper-tiny and Whisper small.en. Nobody listened to them, their transcripts were read only to check the code, and they were deleted.
